title: Expected distribution
view: Shared back-view base (visuals/distribution_bases/back): skeleton on the left, grey body on the right, seen from behind so the patient's right is on the image RIGHT; right-sided block.
teachingPoint: A popliteal sciatic block numbs the posterior and lateral leg below the knee and the foot; the thigh and hip are spared.
claims: Skin: the posterior and lateral leg below the popliteal crease and the foot; the thin medial border strip stays grey (saphenous).
Not shaded: the thigh, the hip and the knee joint (posterior femoral cutaneous and other nerves arise above the popliteal fossa).
Bone: tibia, fibula, ankle and foot bones; the medial distal tibia and medial malleolus are left grey (saphenous periosteal branches; Lundblad et al. 2013, Local Reg Anesth 6:13).
Right-sided block (patient's right on the image right in this back view); one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app.
